packageRules.description: uf updates require reviewed architecture checksums
prBodyNotes: **Manual action required:** Update `UF_SHA256_AMD64` and `UF_SHA256_ARM64` from the `checksums.txt` asset for `v{{newVersion}}`. The image build intentionally fails until both checksums match the new release.

customManagers.description: Track the OpenCode version pin in the FullSend sandbox image
Track the uf CLI version pin. Renovate updates UF_VERSION only; maintainers must update both architecture checksums from the matching signed release checksums.
